title: Commerce Raiding
text: Global Enhancement. At the start of each round, each player with no Location cards in play loses 1 Influence. (Deluxe text change: players with exactly one Location lose 0; players with none lose 2.)

title: Armed Resistance
text: Attach to a Location card. That Location gains +2 Military defense. Opponents targeting this Location lose 1 Influence even if they win.

title: Exploitation
text: Attach to a Location card. That Location provides 1 extra Influence per round.

title: Fleet Support Base
text: Attach to a Location card. One fleet associated with this Location gains +2 Military while this card is in play.

title: Planetary Defenses
text: Attach to a Location card. Opponents must win a Military conflict to take control of this Location.

title: Salvage Yard
text: Attach to a Location card. Once per round, you may take a Fleet card from your discard pile and put it into play at half its Military value (rounded down). (Deluxe text change: may now bring back any fleet at full value once per game.)

title: Triluminary
text: Minbari Character only. That character gains +2 Psi and +2 Diplomacy. Minbari only.

title: Stealth Technology
text: Minbari Fleet only. That fleet gains +3 Military and cannot be targeted by fleet-targeting Enhancement cards.

title: Energy Mines
text: Narn Fleet only. That fleet gains +2 Military. Opponents' fleets that attack this fleet take 1 extra damage.

title: A Good Bluff
text: Play during any conflict. Add 3 to your conflict total. Discard after use.

title: Accident
text: Play during any conflict. One opposing character of your choice is rotated immediately.

title: Armistice
text: Play before a conflict resolves. Cancel one Military conflict. No Aftermath cards may be played. (Deluxe text change: the player who played Armistice gains 1 Influence.)

title: Avert Incident
text: Play when targeted by an Intrigue conflict. Add 2 to your defense total.

title: Balance
text: Play any time. All players gain 1 Influence. No conflicts may be initiated this round after this card is played.

title: Carpe Diem
text: Play during your Action Phase. Take one additional action this round. (Deluxe major change: may now be played during any player's turn, not just your own.)

title: Change of Plans
text: Play before a conflict is initiated. Change the conflict type to a different type of your choice. (Deluxe art/text change: also gain 1 Influence when changing type.)

title: Changing Opinion
text: Play any time. Move one player from supporting to opposing (or vice versa) in an active conflict.

title: Chaos Reigns
text: Play any time. All players must discard one card at random.

title: Chrysalis
text: Minbari only. Play during your Action Phase. Replace Delenn with Delenn Transformed in your Ambassador Zone if she is currently in play. Draw 2 cards.

title: Competing Interests
text: Play before a conflict. One player who is supporting an opponent's conflict must switch to opposing instead, or withdraw from the conflict.

title: Concentrated Effort
text: Play before you initiate a conflict. Gain +3 to that conflict's total. (Deluxe art/text change: bonus increased to +4.)

title: Conflicting Desires
text: Play any time. Choose two players. They must each either support or oppose the current active conflict.

title: Conflicting Loyalties
text: Play any time. Each player must discard one card or rotate one of their Inner Circle characters.

title: Confusion in Chaos
text: Play any time. All players shuffle their hands into their draw piles and draw the same number of cards.

title: Contact with Shadows
text: Play any time. Draw 2 cards. If you have Morden in play, draw 3 cards instead.

title: Contact with Vorlons
text: Play any time. Draw 2 cards from your draw pile.

title: Coordinated Fire
text: Play during a Military conflict you are involved in. Add 2 to your fleet Military total for each fleet you have committed to this conflict. (Deluxe text change: minimum bonus is now 2 even with one fleet.)

title: Cut Supply Lines
text: Play before a Military conflict. One opposing fleet's Military value is halved (rounded down) for this conflict.

title: Declaration of War
text: Play at the start of a round. For this round, all Military conflicts reward 1 extra Influence.

title: Defame Ambassador
text: Play any time. One opponent's ambassador loses 2 Diplomacy until the end of the round. (Deluxe text change: target also loses 1 Influence.)

title: Destiny Fulfilled
text: Play any time. Gain 2 Influence. You may not initiate conflicts this round. (Deluxe art/text change: may now also be played at the end of a round you did not initiate any conflict in for 3 Influence.)

title: Diplomatic Blunder
text: Play after an opponent wins a Diplomacy conflict. That player loses 1 Influence. (Deluxe art/text change: may now be played after any conflict type.)

title: Diplomatic Immunity
text: Play when your ambassador is targeted in a conflict. Your ambassador cannot be targeted this round.

title: Early Warning
text: Play when an opponent initiates a conflict against you. You may look at their hand before the conflict resolves. (Deluxe text change: you may also discard 1 card from their hand.)

title: Emergency Military Aid
text: Play during a Military conflict. Bring one fleet from your hand into play immediately for this conflict only.

title: Fleets on the Border
text: Play at the start of a round. All players' fleets are considered committed to border patrol; fleets cannot be rotated for effects this round.

title: For My People
text: Play any time. One of your faction characters who is in Supporting Role immediately moves to Inner Circle for free. (Deluxe text change: also draw 1 card when this effect triggers.)

title: For the Common Good
text: Play any time. All players gain 1 Influence.

title: For the Good of All
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence for each other player who did not win a conflict this round.

title: Forces Collide
text: Play during a Military conflict. All fleets in play must immediately participate in this conflict. No Aftermath cards may be played afterward.

title: Hidden Knowledge
text: Play any time. Look at one opponent's hand. You may discard one card from it.

title: Hire Raiders
text: Play during a Military conflict. Add 2 to your Military total. Discard this card.

title: Hour of the Wolf
text: Play at the start of a round. For this round, all conflicts cost 1 more Influence to initiate.

title: Internal Strife
text: Play any time. One opponent must rotate one of their Inner Circle characters.

title: Intrigues Mature
text: Play any time. Draw 2 cards.

title: Knowledge of Shadows
text: Play any time. Look at one opponent's entire hand. If they have Morden, gain 1 Influence. (Deluxe text change: may look at 2 opponents' hands if you have Morden in play.)

title: Knowledge of the Soul
text: Play any time. Search your draw pile for any one card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your draw pile.

title: Lack of Subtlety
text: Play after an opponent plays an Event card. Cancel that card's effect. (Deluxe text change: you also gain 1 Influence when cancelling.)

title: Liquidating Assets
text: Play any time. Discard up to 3 cards from your hand. Gain 1 Influence for each card discarded.

title: Lockdown
text: Play at start of round. No player may recruit characters or play Enhancements this round.

title: Long Term Investment
text: Play any time. Pay 2 Influence now; gain 4 Influence at the start of your next turn.

title: Medical Assistance
text: Play any time. Heal one face-down character in your Inner Circle. (Deluxe text change: may now heal up to 2 characters if you have Stephen Franklin in your Inner Circle — even though Franklin is not in Deluxe starters, he is accessible through other means.)

title: Meditation
text: Play any time. Draw 3 cards, then discard 2.

title: Merchandising B5
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence.

title: Moral Quandary
text: Play any time. One opponent must choose: discard 1 card or lose 1 Influence.

title: News of Galactic Import
text: Play any time. All players draw 1 card. (Deluxe text change: if you have the most characters in Inner Circle, draw 2 instead.)

title: Not Meant to Be
text: Play after a conflict resolves. Negate the winner's Influence gain from that conflict. (Deluxe text change: the initiator may not re-initiate that conflict for two rounds.)

title: Political Realignment
text: Play any time. One player must move one of their Inner Circle characters to Supporting Role. That player gains 1 Influence.

title: Prolonged Talks
text: Play before a Diplomacy conflict. That conflict's Influence reward is doubled. All participants must commit their ambassador. (Deluxe text change: both participants draw 1 card after resolution.)

title: Rally to the Cause
text: Play when supporting another player's conflict. Add 2 to the total for the side you are supporting.

title: Ramming
text: Play during a Military conflict. Sacrifice one of your fleets to deal 3 damage to an opposing fleet (reduce that fleet's Military by 3 for this conflict).

title: Recalled to Service
text: Play any time. Return one fleet from your discard pile to play.

title: Sanctions
text: Play any time. One opponent loses 1 Influence for each Location card you have in play.

title: Secret Strike
text: Play before a conflict. You initiate a Military conflict without revealing which fleet you are using until resolution.

title: Secret Vorlon Aid
text: Play any time. Gain 2 Influence. If Kosh Naranek is in your Inner Circle, gain 3 Influence instead.

title: Seduction
text: Play any time. One opponent's Inner Circle character temporarily joins your side for one conflict this round.

title: Self Doubt
text: Play during any conflict. One opposing character loses 2 from their primary stat for this conflict.

title: Shadow Strike
text: Play during a conflict. Add 4 to your total. Your characters cannot be healed after this conflict if you lose.

title: Short Term Goals
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence immediately.

title: Short Term Investment
text: Play any time. Pay 1 Influence; gain 2 Influence at the start of next round.

title: Sneak Attack
text: Play before a conflict. The opponent cannot play Event cards in response to this conflict.

title: Sortie
text: Play during a Military conflict. Your fleets gain +1 Military for each fleet you have committed to this conflict. (Deluxe text change: minimum +2 regardless of fleet count.)

title: Special Ops
text: Play before an Intrigue conflict. Add 3 to your Intrigue total.

title: Strafing Run
text: Play during a Military conflict. The loser's highest Military fleet is rotated.

title: Strategic Reassignment
text: Play any time. Move one character from your Supporting Role to Inner Circle or vice versa for free.

title: Subliminal Influence
text: Play any time. One opponent must support your next conflict, providing their full Psi stat value.

title: Support Babylon 5
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence. One Enhancement card on Babylon 5 is rotated.

title: The Opposition Rises
text: Play during a conflict. All players not currently involved must either support or oppose this conflict. (Deluxe art/text change: players who abstain lose 1 Influence.)

title: The Price of Power
text: Play any time. The player with the most Influence loses 2 Influence. If there is a tie, each tied player loses 1 Influence.

title: Trade Windfall
text: Play any time. Gain 1 Influence for each Location card you have in play. (Deluxe text change: gain 2 Influence per Location if you control 3 or more.)

title: Universe Today Feature
text: Play any time. Reveal your hand. Gain 1 Influence for each Agenda card revealed.

title: Unrecognized Data
text: Play any time. Look at the top 3 cards of any player's draw pile. Leave them in any order.

title: Victory in My Grasp
text: Play when you are winning a conflict. Gain 1 extra Influence from that conflict.

title: Vorlon Rescue
text: Play when one of your Inner Circle characters would be discarded. That character is moved to Supporting Role instead of discarded. (Deluxe text change: character is also healed when moved.)

title: War by Popular Decree
text: Play at start of round. All players must initiate or join a Military conflict this round or lose 1 Influence.

title: What Do You Want?
text: Play any time. One opponent must discard one card of your choice (you name the type: Character, Fleet, etc.).

title: Who Are You?
text: Play any time. One opponent must reveal their entire hand to all players.

title: You Are Not Ready
text: Play when an opponent initiates a conflict against you. That conflict is cancelled; no Aftermath cards may be played.

title: You Know My Reputation
text: Play before initiating a conflict. Add 2 to your total. The opponent may not recruit backup characters.

title: Approval of the Grey
text: Minbari only. Play after winning any conflict. Gain 1 Influence and heal one face-down character.

title: Battle Tested
text: Play after participating in a Military conflict. One of your characters gains +1 Leadership permanently.

title: Blood Oath
text: Play after losing any conflict. Declare a Blood Oath against the winner; your conflicts against them gain +2 for the rest of the game.

title: Casualty Reports
text: Play after a Military conflict. Each player who participated must rotate one fleet. Gain 1 Influence. (Deluxe text change: winner may exempt one fleet from rotation.)

title: Combat Experience
text: Play after participating in a Military conflict. Draw 1 card.

title: Crisis of Self
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a conflict. That opponent must discard 2 cards. (Deluxe type change: now also valid after a Participant loss, not just a clear loss.)

title: Despair
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. That opponent loses 2 Influence.

title: Develop Relationship
text: Play after any conflict. You and one other participant each draw 1 card.

title: Diplomatic Advantage
text: Play after winning a Diplomacy conflict. Gain 2 Influence and draw 1 card.

title: Disenchantment
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Diplomacy conflict. That opponent loses 1 Influence.

title: Disgrace
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Military conflict. That opponent's ambassador is rotated until healed.

title: Enrage
text: Play after losing a Diplomacy conflict. Immediately initiate a free Military conflict against the winner.

title: Exploit Opportunities
text: Play after winning an Intrigue conflict. Draw 2 cards.

title: Focus Your Efforts
text: Play after winning any conflict. Move one card from your discard pile to your hand.

title: Glory
text: Play after winning a Diplomacy or Military conflict. Gain 2 Influence.

title: Grievance
text: Play after winning any conflict. One opponent must discard 1 card. (Deluxe text change: you may also look at their hand before they discard.)

title: Guilt
text: Play on an opponent after they win a Military conflict. That opponent loses 1 Influence.

title: Harvest Souls
text: Play after any conflict. Take 2 cards at random from the losing player's hand. (Deluxe text change: take 1 card from each other participant who lost.)

title: Hidden Agent
text: Play after winning an Intrigue conflict. Look at one opponent's hand and take 1 card of your choice. (Deluxe text change: may now take from any participant, not just the loser.)

title: Hunted
text: Play on an opponent after any Intrigue conflict. That opponent's highest-Intrigue character is damaged.

title: In the Line of Duty
text: Play after any conflict in which your ambassador participated. Heal your ambassador if damaged. (Deluxe text change: also heal one other Inner Circle character.)

title: Inevitable Destiny
text: Play after any conflict. Gain 1 Influence for each character you had participating. (Deluxe text change: minimum 1 Influence even with no characters.)

title: Intolerable Interference
text: Play after losing any conflict. Gain 1 Influence. The winner may not initiate a conflict against you next round. (Deluxe text change: also prevents the winner from supporting conflicts against you.)

title: It Will Be His Undoing
text: Play after losing any conflict. That opponent's ambassador loses 2 from all stats until end of round. (Deluxe text change: effect lasts until end of next round instead.)

title: Lamentations
text: Play after losing any conflict. Heal one face-down character in your Inner Circle.

title: Learning Experience
text: Play after participating in an Intrigue conflict. Draw 1 card.

title: Left Vulnerable
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Diplomacy conflict. That opponent's characters lose 1 Diplomacy until end of round.

title: Loss of Face
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. That opponent loses 1 Influence. (Deluxe text change: opponent also loses 1 from their ambassador's primary stat until healed.)

title: Martyr
text: Play after any conflict in which one of your characters was discarded. Gain 3 Influence. (Deluxe text change: gain 4 Influence if it was your ambassador.)

title: Negotiated Surrender
text: Play after a Military conflict. The loser may keep one fleet from being rotated. Gain 1 Influence. (Deluxe text change: loser also draws 1 card.)

title: News of Defeat
text: Play after a Military conflict. The loser must discard 1 card.

title: Nightmares
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. That opponent must skip drawing a card at end of this round.

title: No Escape
text: Play after a Military conflict. The loser may not withdraw any fleets; all committed fleets are rotated. (Deluxe text change: loser also loses 1 Influence.)

title: Older but Wiser
text: Play after participating in a Diplomacy conflict. Draw 1 card.

title: Paying for Sins
text: Play on an opponent after they lose an Intrigue conflict. That opponent must rotate their highest-Intrigue character. (Deluxe text change: opponent also loses 1 Influence.)

title: Personal Enemies
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. One of your characters gains +1 to all stats when opposing that player this round.

title: Personal Involvement
text: Play after losing any conflict. Draw 1 card. (Deluxe text change: draw 2 cards instead if your ambassador was in the conflict.)

title: Personal Sacrifice
text: Play after winning any conflict. Gain 1 Influence.

title: Protests
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Diplomacy conflict. All other players gain 1 Influence.

title: Public Apology
text: Play on an opponent after they lose a Military conflict. That opponent loses 2 Influence. (Deluxe text change: opponent also cannot initiate Military conflicts next round.)

title: Racial Hatred
text: Play on an opponent after they lose any conflict. All conflicts between you and that player gain +1 for the rest of the game. (Deluxe art change.)

title: Refugees
text: Play after winning a Military conflict. Gain 1 Influence for each Location card you have in play. (Deluxe text change: minimum 1 Influence even with no Locations.)

title: Renowned Victory
text: Play after winning a Military conflict. Gain 1 additional Influence. All your fleets gain +1 Military until end of round.

title: Repairing the Past
text: Play after winning any conflict. Heal one face-down character in your Inner Circle. (Deluxe text change: also draw 1 card.)

title: Rescue
text: Play after a Military conflict. Return one rotated fleet to unrotated state. (Deluxe text change: may now also heal one damaged character.)

title: Retribution
text: Play after winning any conflict. The loser must rotate one of their Inner Circle characters. (Deluxe text change: winner chooses which character is rotated.)

title: Reverse Advances
text: Play after losing a Diplomacy or Intrigue conflict. Negate the winner's Influence gain. (Deluxe text change: you also gain 1 Influence when this negation occurs.)

title: Rise to Power
text: Play after winning a Military conflict. Gain 2 Influence.

title: Rivalry
text: Play after participating in a Diplomacy conflict. Gain 1 Influence if you were the initiator or if you supported the winner. (Deluxe text change: gain 2 Influence if both conditions are true.)

title: Secondary Experience
text: Play after any conflict in which you participated as a supporter and the initiator won. Gain 1 Influence. (Deluxe type change: now classified as Aftermath - Won rather than Aftermath - Won Participant.)

title: Skeletons in the Closet
text: Play after any conflict. Look at the losing player's hand; you may discard 1 card from it.

title: Successful Manipulation
text: Play after winning an Intrigue conflict. Draw 2 cards.

title: Under Pressure
text: Play after losing an Intrigue conflict. Gain 1 Influence.

title: United Front
text: Play after winning a Diplomacy conflict. Gain 1 Influence and draw 1 card.

title: Vendetta
text: Play after losing any conflict. The winner's next conflict gain is reduced by 2.

title: War Hero
text: Play after winning a Military conflict. One of your characters gains +2 Leadership permanently.

title: Wear and Tear
text: Play after a Military conflict. All fleets that participated are rotated. (Deluxe art/text change: winner may exempt one of their own fleets from rotation.)

title: Wounded
text: Play on an opponent after they lose an Intrigue or Military conflict. One of their Inner Circle characters is damaged. (Deluxe text change: you choose which character is damaged.)

title: Commercial Telepaths
text: Rotate this Group and choose a Character. For as long as this Group stays rotated, that Character adds half its Psi (rounded up) to its Diplomacy. (Deluxe rules change: may choose any Character, including opponents'.)

title: Counterintelligence
text: Rotate this Group during any Intrigue conflict. Add 3 to your Intrigue total.

title: Damage Control Team
text: Rotate this Group after any Military conflict. Unrotate one of your fleets. (Deluxe art change: new artwork.)

title: Diplomatic Corps
text: Rotate this Group during any Diplomacy conflict. Add 2 to your Diplomacy total. (Deluxe text change: if you win, draw 1 card.)

title: Extended Contacts
text: Rotate this Group any time. Draw 1 card. (Deluxe text change: draw 2 cards if you have 3+ characters in Inner Circle.)

title: Government Opposition
text: Rotate this Group any time. One opponent loses 1 Influence.

title: Interstellar Corporation
text: At the start of each round, gain 1 Influence.

title: ISN
text: Rotate this Group any time. Force one opponent to reveal their hand to all players.

title: Military Cadre
text: Rotate this Group during any Military conflict. Add 2 to your Military total. (Deluxe text change: bonus increased to +3.)

title: Military Telepaths
text: Rotate this Group during any Psi conflict. Add 3 to your Psi total. (Deluxe text change: also adds +1 to Intrigue conflicts.)

title: Motivated Leaders
text: All your characters in Inner Circle gain +1 Leadership permanently. Discard after this effect triggers.

title: Observers
text: Rotate this Group after any conflict. Look at all players' hands simultaneously. (Deluxe text change: may also discard 1 card from any one hand.)

title: Rabble Rousers
text: Rotate this Group any time. One opponent must discard 1 card.

title: Ranger Strike Team
text: Rotate this Group during any Military or Intrigue conflict. Add 2 to your total. (Deluxe text change: bonus increased to +3.)

title: Rangers Surveillance
text: Rotate this Group any time. Look at the top 3 cards of any player's draw pile and rearrange them. (Deluxe text change: may look at top 5 cards instead.)

title: Secret Police
text: Rotate this Group during any Intrigue conflict. Add 2 to your Intrigue total. If you win, the loser must also rotate one character. (Deluxe text change: bonus increased to +3.)

title: Spin Doctors
text: Rotate this Group after any conflict. Change the perceived winner of a Diplomacy conflict for Influence gain purposes.

title: War College
text: Rotate this Group during any Military conflict. Add 2 to your Military total. (Deluxe text change: also draw 1 card after the conflict resolves.)

title: Imperial Telepaths
text: Centauri only. Rotate this Group during any Psi conflict. Add 3 to your Psi total. If you win, the loser must discard 1 card.

title: Influential Lords
text: Centauri only. At the start of each round, gain 1 Influence if you have 3 or more Centauri characters in your Inner Circle. (Deluxe text change: threshold reduced to 2 characters.)

title: Religious Caste
text: Minbari only. At the start of each round, if you have no damaged characters, gain 1 Influence.

title: Warrior Caste
text: Minbari only. While in play, all Minbari fleets gain +1 Military.

title: Wind Swords
text: Minbari only. Rotate this Group during any Military conflict. Add 3 to your Military total. (Deluxe text change: bonus increased to +4.)

title: Narn Rabble
text: Narn only. Rotate this Group during any Diplomacy or Military conflict. Add 2 to your total.

title: Thenta Makur
text: Narn only. Rotate this Group during any Intrigue conflict. Add 4 to your Intrigue total.

title: Immolan V
text: Centauri colony world. Provides 1 Influence per round. Centauri Military conflicts defending this Location gain +1.

title: Ragesh III
text: Centauri agricultural colony. Provides 1 Influence per round. (Deluxe text change: also provides +1 to Centauri Intrigue conflicts at this location.)

title: Proxima III
text: Human colony. Provides 1 Influence per round. Human Military conflicts here gain +1. (Deluxe text change: also gains +1 to Intrigue conflicts.)

title: Transfer Point Io
text: Neutral trading hub. Any faction may control this. Provides 1 Influence per round. Draw 1 extra card per round while controlling this.

title: Minbari Protectorate
text: Minbari protected world. Provides 1 Influence per round. Minbari Diplomacy conflicts here gain +1.

title: Quadrant 14
text: Narn border territory. Provides 1 Influence per round. Narn Military conflicts here gain +2. (Deluxe text change: bonus also applies when Narn defends this territory.)

title: Quadrant 37
text: Narn outer territory. Provides 1 Influence per round. (Deluxe text change: also gain 1 extra Influence when winning a Military conflict while controlling this.)

title: Sleeping Z'ha'dum
text: Shadow homeworld. Any faction. Provides 2 Influence per round. While in play, all Intrigue conflicts gain +1. Cannot be seized by Diplomacy conflicts. (Deluxe major change: now also cannot be seized by Psi conflicts.)
